A day for curious beginners

Field Notes Saturday

Explore drawing and urban nature on Saturday, May 18, 10:00-16:00, at Linden Community Hall and the adjoining public garden.

Entry is free. Arrive at any time. Materials are provided, and no drawing experience is needed.

Explore the schedule

The day's schedule

  • 10:30 Garden observation walk, 45 minutes.
  • 12:00 Beginner sketching workshop, 60 minutes.
  • 14:00 Seed exchange, 30 minutes.
  • 15:00 Shared sketchbook circle, 45 minutes.

Plan your visit

Bring a water bottle and weather-appropriate clothing. No registration or ticket is required. Children are welcome with an adult.

Access and weather

The hall has step-free entry, an accessible toilet, and a quiet room. Garden paths are compact gravel. Outdoor activities move into the hall in heavy rain.
